result.brief: 提出 EG-Sparse：按注意力头熵值自适应选择竞争域（低熵头用跨头分组池、高熵头保留逐行局部选择）的免训练稀疏注意力，降低视频扩散 Transformer 推理延迟并保持生成质量。
result.reason: Training-free sparse attention for video diffusion transformer inference efficiency, directly serving video generation; head-heterogeneity routing is a concrete efficiency contribution.
